title: Upcoming end of life for the Supervisor API
body:
The Supervisor API (Beta) reaches end of life on September 30, 2026. After that date, the API is no longer available.

Databricks recommends migrating to [custom agents on Databricks Apps](/aws/en/agents/custom-agents/author-agent).

See [Supervisor API (Beta) (deprecated)](/aws/en/agents/agent-bricks/supervisor-api).
